style guide for

  • CURIE: gmeow:styleGuideFor
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/styleGuideFor
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

What this guide voices — a gmeow:Persona or a gmeow:Register value. Range intentionally open across the two. NOT functional (one guide may voice a persona and its register); at least one (SHACL): a style guide for nothing is just a document.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:StyleGuide -> ?

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:styleGuideFor from gmeow:StyleGuide to ? when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:StyleGuide

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use on a StyleGuide to name what it voices — a gmeow:Persona or a gmeow:Register.

Avoid when

  • Avoid a guide that voices nothing (at least one target is required — a style guide for nothing is just a document) and avoid forcing one target; it may voice a persona and its register at once.

How to use

  • Assert gmeow:styleGuideFor from the gmeow:StyleGuide to its gmeow:Persona and/or gmeow:Register; attach the voice payload via gmeow:exemplifiedBy.

Examples

  • ex:clinicalVoice gmeow:styleGuideFor ex:drChen.
